title: spec: composed stacks refuse a datasource whose external.connector names no declared connector instance (composed counterpart of the #27742 check, #25211 shape) — epic #27261
body:
epic:#27261#1 · marchtian · session_017ihL2c5z3q4h8inrn5kwqV
Filing gate: ① should-fix (d) of the contract review of PR #27783 (record 6511230689, VERDICT PASS), not taken into that PR.
Ruling-ref: 6486136301 (#27298, D7)
Dedupe (open AND closed): "composed external.connector datasource connector cross-reference" → 6 hits, none this work.
Reader: the epic PM (#27261) dispatches it in the epic subtree.
Blocked-by: #27742
type: Feature

## 维护者速读

- **做什么：** #27742 在 `defineStack` 严格构建时拒收"数据源点名了不存在的连接器实例"；但多个栈合成（`composeStacks`）时，若某个输入以 `strict: false` 构建，悬空的名字会带进产物而无人报错。补上合成层的同类检查。
- **为什么：** 运行时（#27746）会失败关闭，所以不是漏洞；但作者要等到连接时才知道写错了。
- **需要您做的：** 无。

## Task

- [ ] A composed collector of the #25211 shape (`collectComposedExternalBindingDatasourceErrors` is the precedent) refuses a composed artifact in which a datasource's `external.connector` names no connector instance declared across the composed inputs, or names a descriptor (no `provider`), or an instance with nothing to lend (`auth` absent or `type: 'none'`). It uses the same three findings and fixes as `collectDatasourceConnectorErrors` in `stack.zod.ts`.
- [ ] Tests: a cross-input pair resolved (accepted), a dangling name carried by a `strict: false` input (refused), and a per-stack strict refusal unchanged.

`Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` (a composed artifact accepted today is refused) · `Metadata-protocol: none`. Touches `packages/spec/src/**`: full Fable review and a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` record before landing.
